It include fixed length and variable length data. Parameters (out) ErrorCode If the operation Xxx_Start returns value E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall send a negative response with NRC code equal to the parameter ErrorCode parameter value. Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request was successful. E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful. DCM_E_PENDING: Request is not yet finished. Further call(s) required to finish. DCM_E_FORCE_RCRRP: application requests the transmission of a response Pending (NRC 0x78) Description This function requests to the application to start the execution of a routine. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Dcm_Externals.h
